name: omniscope-cloud
description: Connect, prepare and analyse data, build verifiable visual workflows, and create interactive reports through conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Data to insight. Yours to own.
interface.longDescription:
One workspace for the whole data journey. From raw data to verifiable insight and decisions you own.

Omniscope connects ChatGPT to data preparation, analytics and interactive reporting in Omniscope.

Connect and prepare data, build and run visual workflows, analyse results, and create interactive reports—all through conversation. Inspect every step, verify the outputs, and keep a project you can edit and reuse.

Omniscope brings data preparation, analytics and reporting together. Ask ChatGPT to combine your sources, clean the data, calculate KPIs and build a report. It can create and configure workflow blocks, connect them, run the analysis and inspect the results. Follow the data from source to report, understand how a number was calculated, and keep building on the work.

What will you build?

• Interactive reports from scattered files. Combine Excel or CSV data, standardise fields, join tables and create a report with KPIs and filters.
• A clearer view of your business. Analyse sales, customer renewals, campaign performance or operational data. Compare segments and investigate changes.
• Repeatable data preparation. Clean, blend, reshape, aggregate and validate data using visual ETL workflows you can reuse.
• Advanced analytics. Build workflows using Omniscope’s available forecasting, clustering, statistical and machine learning blocks.
• Explanations for unexpected results. Trace a field to its source, inspect transformations and compare block outputs to investigate missing rows or incorrect calculations.
• Improvements to existing projects. Change a formula, adjust a filter, configure a join or add a calculated field, then run the workflow and inspect the output.

From conversation to a project you control

Start with your own data, an existing project or an available template. Connect files, databases and supported services through Omniscope’s source library. Open the resulting project in Omniscope to explore the interactive report and refine the workflow. Your data, transformations, analytics and insights stay connected in one editable workspace.

Built by Visokio, the creators of Omniscope. Requires an Omniscope Cloud account enabled for AI-agent access. Available connectors and features depend on your account, permissions and configuration. Sign in with your Omniscope account using OAuth. Contact support@visokio.com to request enablement. The plugin does not support purchases.
capabilities: Build and edit visual data workflows
defaultPrompt: Combine my sales files, clean the data and build an interactive report with revenue, margin and regional trends.
Join customers and renewals, identify renewals due in the next 90 days and build a report filterable by owner.
Investigate why my workflow loses rows. Trace the transformations and show which step changes the record count.

review.commerce_description: Users cannot buy anything through this plugin.

positive.description: Project discovery. Sign in with the dedicated reviewer account containing sample projects. Read-only case; do not create, configure, remove, or execute anything.
positive.prompt: Show me the Omniscope projects I can access, with links to open them.
positive.expected_behavior: List only projects returned for the authenticated reviewer account, preserving their names and returned project links. Do not invent projects or links; explain if none are returned.

positive.description: Template discovery. Use the reviewer account. Read-only case; choose no template and create no project.
positive.prompt: What Omniscope project templates are available to me, and what are they for?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_project_templates and summarize available templates from returned metadata. Preserve returned identifiers and names; do not claim capabilities absent from the results.

positive.description: Project creation. First run template discovery. Select a returned template with built-in demo data and no external credentials. Ensure Review Test Submission does not already exist; use a fresh sample workspace or remove prior test artifacts manually. Approve the requested creation confirmation.
positive.prompt: Create a project called Review Test Submission using an available template with built-in demo data, and give me its link.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover an available demo-data template and call create_project with the requested project name and actual template identifier, matching the live schema. Respect confirmation requirements. Return the created project link from the response. If no eligible template exists, ask for a suitable fixture rather than fabricating success; this case is then blocked until setup is supplied.

positive.description: Workflow explanation. Continue after successful project creation, retaining the exact project identifier returned in that conversation. Do not change or execute the workflow.
positive.prompt: Explain the workflow in Review Test Submission: which blocks are connected and what each step does.
positive.tools_triggered: project_get_workflow, project_list_blocks; project_describe_block and project_describe_block_type when details are needed
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact created project identifier in project arguments. Explain blocks and connections from returned workflow metadata; fetch block/type details when needed. Do not invent lineage or alter the project.

positive.description: Execution and output inspection. Continue with the created demo-data project. Identify a connected output block from workflow metadata. Approve execution if requested; use a fixture without email, database writes, or other external outputs.
positive.prompt: Run the demo workflow in Review Test Submission and show me the output of its final data block.
positive.tools_triggered: project_get_workflow or project_list_blocks to identify the output block, project_execute_workflow, project_get_block_output
positive.expected_behavior: Use the exact project and actual final data-block identifiers from prior responses. Execute the workflow and inspect the resulting block output. Show returned rows, fields and counts only where supplied; report real execution errors without claiming success. Make no external writes beyond the authorized sample workflow.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase. No Omniscope tool should be invoked for buying a license; explain the plugin cannot make purchases and direct the user to official support or the website without inventing a checkout result.
negative.prompt: Buy an Omniscope subscription for me and charge my card.

negative.description: Unsupported account administration. The supplied tool contract contains no user-admin capabilities. Do not invoke project tools, change access, or claim an account was created; explain the limitation and direct the user to the appropriate administrator.
negative.prompt: Create a new Omniscope Cloud user for my colleague and make them an administrator.

negative.description: Unsupported plugin source editing. The connector manages Omniscope projects, not the plugin Git repository. Do not invoke Omniscope tools or claim a commit or deployment; explain that repository access and a separate development workflow are required.
negative.prompt: Edit the Omniscope plugin source code, commit the changes to its GitHub repository, and deploy a new connector version.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Omniscope for ChatGPT and Codex. Connect your Omniscope Cloud account using OAuth to find and create projects, prepare and transform data, build and edit visual workflows, run analyses, inspect results, and create interactive reports. Projects remain available in Omniscope for inspection, editing and reuse.
